Specialized Service

PRECISION WHEEL
ALIGNMENT

Proper alignment is crucial for your safety, tire longevity, and fuel efficiency. Our state-of-the-art computerized alignment system ensures your wheels are perfectly calibrated to factory specifications.

When do you need it?

If your car pulls to one side, your steering wheel vibrates, or your tires are wearing unevenly.

The Benefits

Maximize tire life, improve fuel economy, and enjoy a smoother, safer ride.

Book Alignment
System Status
CALIBRATED

Dynamic Balancing

ELIMINATE
VIBRATIONS

If you feel a vibration in your steering wheel at highway speeds, your tires are likely out of balance. We use precision dynamic balancing machines to distribute weight perfectly across the wheel assembly.

  • Smoother highway driving
  • Prevents premature suspension wear

Safe Flat Repair

PROFESSIONAL
PATCHING

Not all flat tires need to be replaced. If a puncture is within the central tread area, our experts can safely patch it from the inside out, strictly following industry safety standards to get you back on the road safely and cheaply.

  • Fast 15-minute turnaround
  • Safer than temporary plugs
